description: Parametric curved-blade generator (scimitar family) at HAND-WEAPON scale: swept diamond profile along an arc, tapered to a true point, with co-authored UVs + EditableImage texture
name: procedural-swept-blade
body:
Claude-authored generator - adapt parameters or sweep path for new families (horns, tusks, curved staffs):
1. Stations list {cf, halfWidth, halfThick, u}: pommel flare (w .11) -> handle rings along +Y (len 0.9, w .085) -> guard disc (two rings, w .21, 0.08 tall) -> blade arc.
2. Blade sweep: R=4.7, angle 35deg, 22 segs: cf = top * CFrame.new(cos(a)*R - R, sin(a)*R, 0) * Angles(0,0,a). Width profile: 0.17 base, slight narrow to s=0.7, yelman flare to 0.20 at s=0.85, then taper to 0.006; halfThick 0.035*(1-s)+0.006. Cap tip with an APEX vertex +0.07 along local Y - a blade MUST converge to a point.
3. Corners per station: spine(-X) v=0, +Z v=.25, edge(+X, convex side) v=.5, -Z v=.75, wrap v=1; u = length fraction (handle 0-0.22, guard 0.26, blade->0.98). AddUV per station, SetFaceUVs per tri.
4. Skin ring pairs with quads; base-cap fan + apex fan. CreateMeshPartAsync.
5. SCALE GATE: check part.Size vs the 5-stud character - hand weapons ~2.5-4 studs tall, thin axis under ~0.3. Then capture and judge silhouette before texture.
6. Texture: EditableImage 512x128; CLAMP every DrawRectangle (w=min(w,W-x), h=min(h,H-y)). Subtle > loud: steel base + soft edge halo rows 54-74 + thin bright core, spine shade at v 0/1 rows, faint 2px streaks; leather grip with wrap bands + brass pommel/guard. part.TextureContent = Content.fromObject(img).
Result verified 2026-07-03: 224 tris, size 1.10 x 3.73 x 0.28.
